chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 99: Ji Ning Discovers a Primordial Liquid Pool & Opens His Zifu
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning's clan discovers a pool of legendary Primordial Liquid in a hidden Immortal's cave. In a touching display of faith, they give it all to their genius, allowing him to open his Zifu.
og_title: A Hidden Treasure and a Heartwarming Family Pact
og_description: After a brutal battle, the Ji Clan finds an Immortal’s ultimate resource. They choose to pour it all into their youngest star, Ji Ning, fueling his breakthrough to the Zifu realm.
twitter_title: Ji Ning's clan finds a treasure stash and immediately gives it ALL to him
twitter_description: In a heartwarming classic, the entire Ji Clan elders decide their genius boy needs the magical 'Primordial Liquid' more than they do. The result is a glorious Zifu breakthrough.
